title: Release v4.3.1 - Public Module Catalog & Interactive Workhub Calculator
tagline: Dynamic module storefront catalog, interactive Workhub calculator, and modular entitlement enforcement.

features: Interactive Workhub ERP modular bundle calculator and showcase explorer on external storefront
Dedicated Workhub platform showcase screen (/workhub) with live pricing and architectural pillars
Database seeder command for 10 canonical Workhub ERP modules with pricing, features, and prerequisites
Dynamic client user context entitlement resolution with isEntitled flags and enabled_modules payload
improvements: Hydrate module catalog dynamically via Populate Engine (/api/populate/read/module)
Added module search fields and public attributes (category, icon, price_per_user_monthly, features, prerequisites)
security: Decoupled Two-Plane PolicyEngine enforcement for Platform vs Client planes
Public and client catalog read access with strict mutation lockdown (HTTP 403) for non-root admins
Strict isolation of private control plane models (tenant, provisioning_run)
